_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/mana/test_grant_pay_generic_with.py. Never part of a deck list. t_statuary is Inspiring Statuary's shape, an artifact whose static hands improvise to its controller's nonartifact spells; t_study is a {3}{U} sorcery with no keyword of its own, and t_relic a {4} artifact with none, so the filter can be seen to bite. t_trinket and t_construct (improvise.cards.json) are the artifacts it taps.
